tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind every page; the sidebar sits on it too.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs, the top bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: code, read-only values, chat history, table headers.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards and between rows. Decorative only, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders; 3:1 on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, labels, table headers, metadata on bg, surface and surface-sunken (>= 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps and helper text on surface (>= 4.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal: primary buttons, active nav, links, focus ring, selected chips. One accent; never decorative.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows and nav items, accent badges, the AI match highlight.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft (badges, selected nav label).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Rating stars and the 'Featured' highlight. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational alert icon and text; scheduled or pending-on-others states.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info alerts and badges; info text reads on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed, paid, approved. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, held, expiring. Text colour on warning-soft and surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive buttons, rejected and cancelled states.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error alerts and danger badges.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the mobile nav drawer.
